title: Signed copy of Alien Conspiracy
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Signed copy of Alien Conspiracy, about 2004 at United States (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: lo and behold, on the first page, it was signed [music] by Chris Evans, dated December 1st, 2004.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says he came across a copy of a work called Alien Conspiracy, and when he opened it the first page was signed by a man named Chris Evans and dated December 1st, 2004. Michels tells it as a find that links Evans to the material, which he presents as part of his search for proof of crashed alien bodies.
